verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a terminal emulator and multiplexer, not an agent, so an official MCP server exposing panes and tabs to agents is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack has no MCP server of any kind. The documented `wezterm cli` for spawning programs and manipulating panes is only a building block an agent could script against, not an MCP server, so it earns no credit.
